idea-plugin.name: Bean Copy Companion
idea-plugin.description:
Generates a real, compiling object-copy method between two Java or Kotlin classes -- select exactly two class files in the Project view, pick the copy direction, and get a new copier file with fields matched by name and type. The #1 complaint against the closest existing competitor in this space (a plugin with real crash reports and a "does not support Kotlin" review) is exactly what this plugin is built to not do: every field it can't safely map (type mismatch, no matching name, no way to set it) becomes an honest // TODO comment in the generated file instead of a crash or a silently wrong copy. The generated text is parsed against a throwaway in-memory PSI file and checked for syntax errors before anything touches disk -- same discipline already proven in this catalog's Test Scaffold Companion and Refactor Simulator.

Real support for what the competitor lacks: Kotlin data class targets (constructor-based, since val properties have no setter), Java 17+ record targets (canonical constructor), and Lombok @Builder targets -- all detected from the plain PSI tree, no Lombok/Kotlin compiler plugin dependency required.

100% local -- no network call, no account, no telemetry. All PSI analysis runs off the EDT; only the final file write touches it, and only after validation already passed.

action.description: Generates a real, in-memory-validated field-copy method between the two selected classes -- fields matched by name and type, unmappable fields left as honest TODOs
